The '''Ligna system''' was located in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] known as [[Lignan]].<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Lignan]]|system=Ligna [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ligna [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-4.<ref name="TEA" />
